name: io.github.AbduljabbarBXR/cornea
title: Cornea — deterministic visual inspection
description: Deterministic visual inspection of pages (overlap, overflow, contrast, quality) as native agent tools. Token-cheap, no Chromium.

tools.name: layout.inspect
tools.description: Full deterministic visual model + quality summary of a page.

tools.name: layout.overlaps
tools.description: Elements whose boxes collide in viewport space.

tools.name: layout.contrast
tools.description: WCAG AA contrast ratios for text elements.

tools.name: layout.quality
tools.description: Combined 0..1 health score with issue list.

tools.name: layout.fidelity
tools.description: Which CSS features are exact vs approximated in the engine.
